description: Get one provider (for example GitHub, AWS, Vercel, OpenAI): a one-line verdict on whether it reports a problem now, its active incidents, what people reported about it on outages.live in the last 24 hours (reviewed reports only, with a spike flag when many arrive in an hour), maintenance in progress, its last 10 incidents, and 90 days of daily history. Give region or component to keep only active incidents that name it, for example us-east-1 or Actions. Call it when a request to the provider fails, before you change code. An unknown name returns every tracked id.

component.description: Optional component or product to match, for example Actions, S3, Chat Completions

provider.description: Provider id or name, for example github, aws, Google Cloud, openai

region.description: Optional region to match, for example us-east-1

name: get_provider
title: Get a provider's status
